title: PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers
abstract: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have narrowed the image quality gap with latent-space diffusion, but still converge more slowly and lag behind in final image quality. We argue that a key reason is the lack of an explicit representation prior: unlike latent diffusion, which usually denoises in a compact and structured latent space, pixel diffusion needs to learn denoising-friendly representations and pixel generation simultaneously from raw RGB space. To address this problem, we propose PixelDiT2, an end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model designed to decouple representation learning from pixel generation without introducing an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck. We propose representation grounding that uses a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance throughout denoising, allowing the pixel diffusion transformer to focus more on pixel generation. On ImageNet-256x256, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.46 after 600 epochs; at 512x512 resolution, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.48 after 680 epochs. Project page: this https URL

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Welcome to our seminar on Transformer Architectures. Today's lecture is on a paper from researchers at NVIDIA and the University of Rochester titled 'PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers'. We've seen a trend where many high-quality models operate in a latent space, while pixel-space models like the original PixelDiT try to generate images directly. This paper investigates a way to improve those direct pixel-space models by giving them a better sense of visual structure without forcing them into a latent space. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 欢迎来到我们的Transformer架构研讨会。今天的讲座围绕NVIDIA和罗切斯特大学研究人员的论文《PixelDiT2：基于表征的像素扩散Transformer》展开。我们观察到一种趋势：许多高质量模型都在潜空间里运作，而像最初的PixelDiT这样的像素空间模型则试图直接生成图像。这篇论文探索了一种方法，在不强迫模型进入潜空间的前提下，让这些直接的像素空间模型对视觉结构有更好的感知。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Excuse me, Professor. You mentioned the split between latent-space and pixel-space models. What's the fundamental tradeoff that keeps both research directions active?
segments.zh: 教授，不好意思打断一下。您刚才提到隐空间模型和像素空间模型之间的分野。那到底是什么根本性的权衡，让这两个研究方向都一直有人在做呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's the central tension here. Latent diffusion is computationally cheaper because it operates on a compressed representation, but you're always limited by the quality of your autoencoder. It can introduce artifacts. Pixel-space diffusion is more direct and end-to-end, but it's much harder because the model has to learn everything from raw pixels, which is a very high-dimensional problem. It often converges slower and, until recently, produced lower-quality images.
segments.zh: 这正是核心矛盾所在。潜空间扩散计算上更便宜，因为它在压缩后的表征上操作，但你始终受限于自编码器的质量，它可能引入伪影。像素空间扩散更直接、更端到端，但难度大得多，因为模型得从原始像素里学一切，而这是一个非常高维的问题。它往往收敛更慢，而且直到最近，生成的图像质量也偏低。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So PixelDiT2 is trying to get the benefits of pixel-space without the slow training and representation learning burden.
segments.zh: 所以PixelDiT2想拿到像素空间的好处，又不想背上训练慢和表示学习的包袱。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Precisely. The core idea is to decouple the task of learning visual representations from the task of generating pixels. The authors argue that a pixel-space model has to solve two problems at once: first, figure out what a 'dog' looks like conceptually, and second, figure out which pixels to draw to make that dog. Latent models get a head start because the autoencoder has already organized some of that conceptual knowledge into the latent space.
segments.zh: 没错。核心思路就是把学习视觉表征和生成像素这两件事拆开。作者认为，像素空间模型得同时解决两个问题：第一，在概念上搞清楚“狗”长什么样；第二，搞清楚该画哪些像素才能画出这只狗。而潜空间模型之所以有先发优势，是因为自编码器已经把一部分概念知识组织进了潜空间里。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So how does PixelDiT2 provide that head start without using an autoencoder?
segments.zh: 那么PixelDiT2是如何在不使用自编码器的情况下提供这种先发优势的呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It uses what the paper calls 'representation grounding'. At every single step of the denoising process, it takes the current noisy image and feeds it through a frozen, pretrained vision encoder—in this case, DINOv3. The features from this encoder are then used to guide the diffusion transformer as it predicts the next step. The diffusion model itself stays entirely in pixel space, but it's constantly receiving high-level guidance about the content and structure of the image it's trying to form.
segments.zh: 它用了一种论文里叫做“表征锚定”的方法。在去噪过程的每一步，它都会把当前带噪的图像送进一个冻结的、预训练好的视觉编码器——这里用的是DINOv3。然后编码器输出的特征会用来引导扩散Transformer预测下一步。扩散模型本身完全待在像素空间里，但它一直在接收关于它想要生成的图像内容和结构的高层引导。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Wait, they run a big vision encoder at every denoising step? That sounds computationally expensive for inference.
segments.zh: 等等，他们在每个去噪步骤都跑一个大型视觉编码器？那推理时的计算开销听起来很大啊。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It is. That's one of the key limitations and tradeoffs. It adds computational overhead at inference time compared to a model that doesn't use this mechanism. But the authors' bet is that the improvement in sample quality and training efficiency is worth the cost. Now, let's look at how they make this work technically, because it's not straightforward.
segments.zh: 确实是这样。这是关键的局限和权衡之一。跟不使用这个机制的模型相比，它在推理时会增加计算开销。但作者赌的是，样本质量和训练效率的提升值得这个代价。接下来我们看看他们在技术上是怎么实现的，因为这并不简单。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What's the main challenge?
segments.zh: 主要的挑战是什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The DINOv3 encoder was trained on clean images, but in a diffusion process, it has to process very noisy images, especially at early timesteps. The raw features it extracts from a noisy image are quite different from those it would get from a clean one. Simply feeding these unstable features to the denoiser wouldn't work well.
segments.zh: DINOv3编码器是在干净图像上训练的，但在扩散过程中，它得处理噪声非常大的图像，尤其是在早期时间步。它从噪声图像里提取的原始特征，跟从干净图像里得到的特征差别很大。直接把这些不稳定的特征喂给去噪器，效果不会好。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So they have to adapt the features. Did they fine-tune the encoder?
segments.zh: 所以他们得对这些特征做适配。那他们有没有微调编码器呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Interestingly, no. The ablation studies showed that keeping the vision encoder frozen and adapting its outputs downstream worked better. They introduce a small, trainable projection network. This network takes the raw features from the DINOv3 encoder and, conditioned on the current diffusion timestep, transforms them into stable 'grounding tokens'. The analysis shows these projected tokens maintain high similarity to clean-image features across all noise levels, providing a consistent signal for the denoiser.
segments.zh: 有意思的是，并没有。消融实验表明，把视觉编码器冻结、只在下游适配它的输出效果更好。他们引入了一个小型可训练的投影网络。这个网络接收DINOv3编码器输出的原始特征，并以当前扩散时间步为条件，把它们转换成稳定的“grounding token”。分析显示，这些投影后的token在所有噪声水平下都与干净图像的特征保持高度相似，从而为去噪器提供了一致的信号。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: And how are these grounding tokens used by the main diffusion transformer?
segments.zh: 那主扩散Transformer又是怎么使用这些接地token的呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Through a mechanism they call Spatial AdaLN, or Spatial Adaptive Layer Normalization. Since the DINOv3 encoder produces one feature token per image patch, they have a set of grounding tokens that are spatially aligned with the diffusion transformer's own tokens. They use these grounding tokens to modulate the normalization layers inside the transformer on a per-patch basis. This is a critical detail. It provides local, spatially-aware guidance, rather than just adding a single global token that averages information across the whole image.
segments.zh: 他们用了一种叫 Spatial AdaLN 的机制，也就是空间自适应层归一化。因为 DINOv3 编码器会为每个图像块生成一个特征 token，所以他们得到了一组与扩散 Transformer 自身 token 在空间上对齐的 grounding token。他们用这些 grounding token 在逐图像块的层面上调制 Transformer 内部的归一化层。这个细节很关键。它提供的是局部的、具备空间感知的引导，而不是只加一个全局 token 把整张图的信息平均一下。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: This approach is a distinct alternative to related ideas. For instance, the REPA paper uses pretrained representations as a training target to align the diffusion model's internal features, but the encoder isn't used during sampling. PixelDiT2 uses the encoder actively during both training and sampling.
segments.zh: 这种方法与一些相关思路截然不同。比如REPA那篇论文是把预训练表征当作训练目标，来对齐扩散模型的内部特征，但编码器在采样阶段并不参与。而PixelDiT2在训练和采样两个阶段都主动使用编码器。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So REPA is like giving the student a better textbook to study from, while PixelDiT2 is like having an expert tutor looking over the student's shoulder and giving advice at every step.
segments.zh: 所以REPA就像是给学生一本更好的教材去学习，而PixelDiT2就像是有一位专家导师站在学生旁边，每一步都给出建议。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's a good analogy. And it also differs from models that use representation autoencoders, which define a new latent space to diffuse in. Here, the diffusion trajectory remains entirely in pixel space; the representations are purely for conditioning. The paper shows that combining REPA and their grounding method actually yields the best results, suggesting the two mechanisms are complementary. The REPA loss helps organize the model's internal world, while the grounding provides explicit, on-the-fly guidance.
segments.zh: 这个类比很贴切。它也和那些使用表征自编码器的模型不同，后者会定义一个新的潜空间来做扩散。而在这里，扩散轨迹完全保持在像素空间中，表征纯粹用于条件控制。论文表明，把REPA和他们的 grounding 方法结合起来，效果其实是最好的，这说明这两种机制是互补的。REPA损失帮助组织模型的内部世界，而 grounding 则提供明确的、实时的引导。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So what are the main results? Does this actually make pixel-space models competitive?
segments.zh: 那么主要结果是什么？这真的能让像素空间模型变得有竞争力吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: On ImageNet, it does. At 512x512 resolution, it achieved a new best FID score among the pixel-space models they compared against, reaching an FID of 1.48. It also appeared to converge faster in terms of training epochs. This suggests that providing this external representational scaffold allows the diffusion model to focus its capacity on the pixel synthesis task, leading to more efficient learning and higher final quality.
segments.zh: 在ImageNet上，确实可以。在512x512分辨率下，它在所对比的像素空间模型中取得了新的最佳FID分数，达到了1.48。从训练轮数来看，它似乎也收敛得更快。这表明，提供这种外部表征脚手架让扩散模型能够把容量集中在像素合成任务上，从而实现更高效的学习和更高的最终质量。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: So, to wrap up, PixelDiT2 presents a compelling design for pixel-space diffusion. It uses a frozen foundation model as an active component during inference to provide spatial, timestep-aware guidance. This helps bridge the performance gap with latent diffusion models, though at the cost of increased inference computation. The main takeaway is that we can separate representation learning from pixel generation without necessarily creating a latent bottleneck, offering a new path for building powerful, end-to-end generative models. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 总之，总结一下，PixelDiT2为像素空间的扩散模型提出了一个很有吸引力的设计。它在推理过程中把一个冻结的基础模型当作活跃组件来用，提供空间上、对时间步敏感的引导。这有助于缩小与潜在扩散模型之间的性能差距，不过代价是推理计算量增加了。最核心的结论是，我们可以把表征学习和像素生成分开，而不必非得制造一个潜在瓶颈，这为构建强大、端到端的生成模型开辟了一条新路。感谢收听。如果还有别的问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
